title: Requesting Modern Generator parts for kid model.

posts.author: Hyperion_Oblivion
posts.body:
Hello everyone,
I hope this message finds you well. I'm currently in the process of creating an RPG using RPG Maker MV, and I'm planning to gift it to some friends. They've expressed interest in having additional clothing options for their characters, specifically two different sets for the Kid model. One set should include a plain hoodie and skirt, ideally with the Mary Jane shoes to complete the look. The other set should feature shorts and a jacket, preferably with the sneakers.
I've attached some reference images in the thread to give you a better idea of the outfits I'm looking for. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and I appreciate any help you can offer in finding these resources.
Thank you for your time, and I wish you all a wonderful day ahead.

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body: MV Season pass has child parts. For extra parts look at the generator parts by WhtDragon and HiddenOne. There is no hoodie in there, but dresses, a skirt and shorts with a t-shirt.
